changes.comment: A daemon now records each detached operation process as soon as Node has started it, instead of on its 'spawn' event, and marks each detached spawn while it runs, so that a reclaim also stops an operation process that the daemon died while starting. A failure to record the child never reaches the code that spawned it, and a reclaim reads no process for a spawn mark while the old daemon's pid is still alive and not reused.
